facts.fact: The webinar synthesis (2024) describes a cooperation project in Bizerte (about 140,000 inhabitants) to develop three services, among them electronic payment of municipal fees and GRB 2.0 to digitalise the commune's budget resource management processes; it says online payment was not used by citizens, and names no other commune.

systems.country_label: Gestion des Ressources Budgétaires (GRB 2.0) and paiement électronique des redevances municipales
